edits.new: is added by this story's own Flyway version (GAP-2689; ASM-4436). The check constraint on the standard state column carries SUBMITTED, APPROVED and REFUSED, and the four credit columns carry the reason rule and the result-date rule of AC3. The state refusal has its own message, Not specified in the source documents (GAP-2689). One result per treatment is held by the credit_result_at value and the version guard of AC5 (GAP-2689). The credit-result write declares Decision log right A, as the TSD does for API-P7-003 and API-P7-005; the Treatment and offer right U stays on the pack endpoint of rwb-integration, where a role without it reads MSG-P4-002 (GAP-2481). A D5 row for a treatment carries source_type CREDIT_APPROVAL and source_ref the treatment id, and APPROVED maps to approve and REFUSED to refuse on that row (GAP-2482). The local decision record is announced as rwb.decision.DecisionRecorded.v1 with identifiers, codes, levels and dates only (GAP-2483).
